mapper.select: select t2.* from ( select t.*, t.project_id source_key, (select wm_concat( fat.FILE_NAME ) from fnd_atm_attachment fat, fnd_atm_attachment_multi faam where fat.attachment_id = faam.attachment_id and faam.table_name = 'CT_ABS_PROJECT_ATTACHMENT' and faam.table_pk_value = t.project_attachment_id ) file_name, (select max(fat.last_update_date) from fnd_atm_attachment fat, fnd_atm_attachment_multi faam where fat.attachment_id = faam.attachment_id and faam.table_name = 'CT_ABS_PROJECT_ATTACHMENT' and faam.table_pk_value = t.project_attachment_id) upload_date, (select max(su.description) from sys_user su, fnd_atm_attachment fat, fnd_atm_attachment_multi faam where fat.attachment_id = faam.attachment_id and faam.table_name = 'CT_ABS_PROJECT_ATTACHMENT' and faam.table_pk_value = t.project_attachment_id and su.user_id = fat.last_updated_by) upload_person FROM ct_abs_project_attachment t) t2 where t2.source_key = #{sourceKey} and t2.project_attachment_category = 'CT_ABS_PROJECT'

select t2.* from ( select t.*, (select wm_concat( fat.FILE_NAME ) from fnd_atm_attachment fat, fnd_atm_attachment_multi faam where fat.attachment_id = faam.attachment_id and faam.table_name = 'CT_ABS_PROJECT_ATTACHMENT' and faam.table_pk_value = t.project_attachment_id ) file_name, (select max(fat.last_update_date) from fnd_atm_attachment fat, fnd_atm_attachment_multi faam where fat.attachment_id = faam.attachment_id and faam.table_name = 'CT_ABS_PROJECT_ATTACHMENT' and faam.table_pk_value = t.project_attachment_id) upload_date, (select max(su.description) from sys_user su, fnd_atm_attachment fat, fnd_atm_attachment_multi faam where fat.attachment_id = faam.attachment_id and faam.table_name = 'CT_ABS_PROJECT_ATTACHMENT' and faam.table_pk_value = t.project_attachment_id and su.user_id = fat.last_updated_by) upload_person FROM ct_abs_project_attachment t) t2 where t2.project_id = #{projectId} and t2.project_attachment_category = 'CT_ABS_REGISTER_INFO'
